description: Inspect an uploaded DOCX and report the fillable fields it carries: the markers found in the document, each configured by the filters written in it, the named conditions from that manifest, and any structural marker errors. With templateId, inspects the stored template and linked clauses using the fill discovery owner; otherwise reads the supplied bytes. Stores nothing.

alternative.limitation: returns the discovered fields of a template already stored; it cannot inspect a newly supplied DOCX
